name: South Central Polymers Inc.
old_description: We are a custom thermoplastic injection molding company based in Booneville, Mississippi — specializing in manufacturing, quality, design, and packaging.
about:
South Central Polymers Inc., doing business as SCP Polymers, is a custom thermoplastic injection molding company based in Booneville, Mississippi. The business is led by a management team that includes CEO Bud Hanna, President Joshua S. Hanna, Ph.D., and Vice President Grant Hinton, who together bring more than 75 years of combined industry experience. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

SCP Polymers offers a full range of plastic manufacturing services, including custom injection molding, CAD design support, in-house tooling development, quality inspection, and packaging and logistics. The company states it can accommodate parts of all sizes from prototype through full production runs, though specific facility dimensions, employee count, and annual volume figures are not provided.

The company serves customers across the United States and internationally, but the available information does not list specific industry verticals or named clients.

SCP Polymers emphasizes its in-house tooling capabilities as a means to shorten lead times and reduce costs, and it highlights rigorous dimensional and cosmetic verification before shipment as a quality differentiator.
